warnings: THIS DETAIL IS DRAWN ONCE AND APPLIES TO ALL THREE BATHROOMS - it is titled แบบขยายธรณีประตูห้องน้ำ without naming a room, and it is the only threshold detail in the set. A-11 and A-13 carry no equivalent.

IT SHOWS THE STRUCTURAL REASON THE BATHROOM FLOORS DROP 50 mm. The concrete slab is recessed under the wet area and made up with ปูนทรายปรับระดับ before tiling, which is what puts the bathrooms at +3.95 against the +4.00 rooms around them - the 50 mm step is a finish level, not a separate slab.
NO DIMENSION IS PRINTED ON THIS DETAIL AT ALL - it is a purely annotated build-up. Nothing was scaled off it.
